name: Leprechaun brotherhood
description:
Leprechaun brotherhood — a mysterious group of master-wizards who can neatly handle gold and gems better than anyone else. Their magic is known for its power and unusual abilities that they use in battles.

There is a leprechaun-wizard in the brotherhood who has magical powers and can bring an army of gold golems to a battlefield to attack an opponent. There is also an alchemist-dwarf, whose knowledge of chemistry let them create potions and elixirs to boost combart abilities of the team.
